content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PROD runtime-proxy p95 latency > 600ms (alert pd_4623). Page dispatched to on-call.

jamie: acked — I'm taking this. grabbing dashboards + recent deploys.

maria: saw a tiny blip in canary a couple mins earlier, might be related. no 5xx spike in frontend.

shane: checking autoscaler + proxy logs now. I see a short burst of 50k req/min at ~14:03 UTC, router queues jumped.

jamie: quick check of SLOs: 5m window shows p95=720ms at 14:03:02 then back to ~120ms by 14:05:30. No correlated 5xxs.

jamie: logs snippet: 
```
$ curl -s 'https://telemetry.prod/api/metrics?m=proxy_latency&range=5m' | jq .summary
{"p50":120,"p95":720,"p99":1200,"peak_ts":"2026-02-18T14:03:02Z"}
# back to baseline by 14:05:30
```

maria: :eyes: tiny window, sounds like transient load spike. Did PD auto-resolve yet?

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: alert pd_4623 auto-resolved at 4623005789 (no manual ack required).

jamie: marking initial assessment: NO_CUSTOMER_IMPACT. Short-lived p95 blip, no error-rate increase. I'll create a ticket for follow-up.

alex: thanks. suggestion: increase noise-suppression/debounce for the runtime-proxy p95 alert from 60s -> 180s to reduce flapping. low risk for missing sustained issues.

shane: +1 from infra. I'll add a temporary suppression rule to mute repeated identical alerts for 5m, and annotate monitoring.

maria: creating follow-up INFRA ticket with graphs and query context: INFRA-2041. Adding playbook excerpt and raw logs.

jamie: runbook snippet to save here: 
```
runbook: runtime-proxy p95 alert
- ack the page
- check SLO dashboard (last 5m / 1h)
- check canary proxies and autoscaler logs
- if p95 > 500ms for >5m AND error rate rising -> escalate to eng-runtime
- otherwise add note and watch for recurrence
```

alex: leaving note for next on-call: if recurs, escalate to eng-runtime and open a mid-priority incident so we can correlate traces.

shane: monitoring annotation added. suppression rule will be active for 24h while we observe patterns.

maria: adding "no customer impact" tag and closing PD incident. cc @eng-runtime in INFRA-2041 for awareness. :white_check_mark:

jamie: handing off to next on-call — thread summary posted in #incident-logs. If anything flutters, re-open and ping directly.

alex: :thumbsup: nice quick triage.

maria: thread closed — resolved by auto-clear, follow-up ticket created.
